# Therapy Source

> Therapy Source is a leading school-based therapy staffing platform connecting schools nationwide with licensed therapists, educators, and specialized professionals to meet Special Education and IDEA compliance requirements.

Therapy Source specializes in recruiting and placing Speech-Language Pathologists, Occupational Therapists, Physical Therapists, School Psychologists, and Special Education Teachers in K-12 schools. The company operates TheraWeb, a HIPAA/FERPA-compliant teletherapy platform, and provides comprehensive provider support through timesheets, payroll, credentialing, and professional development solutions.

- Special Education & IDEA Compliance

## Therapy Staffing Solutions

- [Pediatric Therapy Staffing and Related Services](https://txsource.com/therapy-staffing): Core therapy staffing solutions including speech, OT, PT via TheraWeb telepractice platform.
- [School-Based Therapy Jobs](https://txsource.com/school-based-therapy-jobs): School-based therapy job opportunities for SLPs, OTs, PTs, and special ed teachers nationwide.
- [Speech Therapy](https://txsource.com/speech-therapy): Speech therapy services with SLPs specializing in communication and speech disorders.
- [Special Education](https://txsource.com/special-education): Special education staffing aligned with IEP and IDEA requirements.
- [School Psychology](https://txsource.com/school-psychology): School psychology professionals for IEPs and student assessment services.
- [Job Board](https://jobs.txsource.com/index.smpl): Job board for therapy and healthcare career positions nationwide.

## Technology & Teletherapy

- [Teletherapy Solution](https://txsource.com/teletherapy-solution): TheraWeb teletherapy platform for remote school therapy services with HIPAA/FERPA compliance.
- [TSI Provider Hub](https://txsource.com/tsi-provider-hub): Provider hub for timesheets, payroll, and onboarding via iSolved and Able platforms.
- [Therapy Source Provider Portal](https://txsource.com/tsi-portal): Provider portal for timesheet, payroll, and credentialing management.
